phase3_findings.description: src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 75-106: _CATALOG_SCHEMAS_BY_DIALECT and _CATALOG_NAME_PREFIXES_BY_DIALECT must share keys (and match sqlglot_dialect_for_url's return values) but only a comment enforces it; _catalog_names checks the schemas dict then indexes the prefixes dict, so a one-sided key would raise KeyError outside the classifier's try. Key sets agree today.

src/sqllens/tools/_format.py lines 251-254: dialect is an open str; a name sqlglot does not know may make parse_one fail, and the classifier fails open to False so catalog results would be shown. Unreachable from the production caller today.

src/sqllens/tools/_format.py lines 565-576: components_to_markdown has no dialect parameter and always classifies under the all-engine union, while the module docstring calls it the same walker. No caller in src/.
src/sqllens/tools/_format.py lines 386-394: a withheld introspection DataFrame is dropped with no log line, so operators cannot tell an empty turn from a suppressed result.

src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 133-136: the fail-open except Exception now also decides whether a catalog result is shown, and leaves no server-side record when a parse failure lets one through.

docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md line 55: 'withholds from the user the result of every run_sql query the classifier marks as introspection' is broader than the code; a SHOW yields a row-count NotificationComponent, not a DataFrame, which can still reach the Markdown on a turn with no blocks.
docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md line 68: wording can be read as pg_catalog applying to postgres and mysql; code scopes it to postgres only.
src/sqllens/tools/_format.py lines 360-361: comment says 'row counting above still sees it' but the row-count update the DataFrame feeds is below, at lines 398-400.

tests/unit/test_format.py lines 1954-1957: no test for a chart emitted after an introspection run_sql card, and fail-open is tested only with dialect=None, not under a configured dialect (criterion 7 leave-unchanged items).

docs/internal/mcp-server/tools.md lines 110-116 and 193: the sqllens/blocks wire-contract bullets and the query_database_impl_with_widgets paragraph were not updated to say an introspection DataFrame produces no block.
